title: synth-vdr findings
description: The answer-key document listing every planted finding in a synthetic data room. YAML is canonical; this schema documents the shape for anyone authoring or generating a key by hand.

id.description: Stable identifier for the finding, e.g. "ENV-1".

workstream.description: The DD workstream this finding belongs to, e.g. "environmental".

multi_document.description: True if the finding requires corroboration across more than one document. Must be true if and only if corroboration is non-empty.

source.description: Relative path to the primary evidence document.

location.description: Where within the source document the finding sits, e.g. "Table 4".

corroboration.description: Relative paths to documents that corroborate the finding. Non-empty if and only if multi_document is true.

substance.description: What the finding actually says — the fact being planted.

cross_links.description: IDs of other findings this one relates to. Every id must resolve to a finding in this document.

discoverable_from_blind.description: Whether an audit confirmed the finding is discoverable from the blind (unflagged) room. Null until audited.

audit_note.description: Free-text note left by the discoverability audit.
